decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the products provided, I filtered for those that functioned primarily as standard backpacks. The HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) stood out immediately due to its high volume of reviews (2872) and high rating (4.7), suggesting consistent quality and durability. The SHENHU 40L was a strong runner-up for larger capacity, but the HIKPRO's portability and established user feedback made it the most reliable choice for a general-purpose daypack. The other options in my consideration set included a specialized dry bag and a fan-themed bag, but for a standard backpack purchase, the HIKPRO represents the best value and performance balance.
